content: Acceptance evidence: linked document 191c9f38-93d0-4c0f-95e5-d2fe121c445a defines eight-crate/app workspace boundaries, allowed and forbidden dependency direction, single-writer project actor, GUI/IPC/asset/offline worker ownership, and explicit allocation/blocking/I/O prohibitions for audio callback. It also records modern polished desktop UI as product requirement with responsive, accessible, high-DPI, reusable-component, live-update, prototype, and rendered visual-review gates.
